record.original_question: Describe closed manifolds M which admit Nijenhuis operators L(x) that are alge- braically regular at each point x ∈ M.

evidence.quote: Problem 5.10. Describe closed manifolds M which admit Nijenhuis operators L(x) that are alge- braically regular at each point x ∈ M.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth closed (compact, without boundary) manifold of dimension $n$. A Nijenhuis operator on $M$ is a smooth (1,1)-tensor field $L:TM\to TM$ whose Nijenhuis torsion
$$
\mathcal{N}_L(X,Y) := L^2[X,Y] - L[LX,Y] - L[X,LY] + [LX,LY]
$$
vanishes identically for all smooth vector fields $X,Y$ on $M$. At a point $x\in M$, the operator $L(x):T_xM\to T_xM$ is called algebraically regular if its centralizer in $\mathrm{End}(T_xM)$ has the minimal possible dimension $n$, equivalently if the characteristic and minimal polynomials of $L(x)$ coincide (each eigenvalue of $L(x)$ corresponds to a single Jordan block). The operator $L$ is called algebraically regular on $M$ if $L(x)$ is algebraically regular for every $x\in M$.

Describe (i.e., classify, or give effective topological/geometric obstructions and constructions for) the closed manifolds $M$ that admit a Nijenhuis operator $L$ which is algebraically regular at every point of $M$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is part of an active research program in Nijenhuis geometry. Partial results exist: normal forms for gl-regular Nijenhuis operators (each eigenvalue a single Jordan block) have been obtained locally and near singular points, and some topological restrictions on closed surfaces are known, but a general description/classification of closed manifolds admitting algebraically regular Nijenhuis operators does not appear to have been achieved. Recent surveys of research problems in Nijenhuis geometry continue to list such questions as open.
